mapper.sql: select task_id, factory_id, biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, target_system, callback_path, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, create_time, update_time from qxx_sys_sync_task
mapper.insert: insert into qxx_sys_sync_task (biz_type, biz_id, biz_no, target_system, callback_path, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time) values (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{targetSystem}, #{callbackPath}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime})
mapper.select: where status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED') and retry_count < 10 and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= #{now}) order by task_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update qxx_sys_sync_task set status = 'RUNNING', update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

update qxx_sys_sync_task set status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and factory_id = #{factoryId}
